captions.instagram:
How are noodles made?

A noodle is starch held in a net, pressed into a thread and set by heat. Pull one rope of dough into 4,096 strands, cook a strand from the outside in, then run an instant noodle line: steam, wave, and a minute in 150 °C oil that leaves every strand full of pores.

→ A noodle is starch granules held in a net of protein, shaped and then set by heat.
→ Alkaline salts called kansui turn a wheat noodle yellow, firm and springy. No egg needed.
→ Hand-pulled lamian doubles with every fold. Twelve pulls turn one rope into 4,096 strands.
→ Rice dough cannot stretch, so idiyappam and sevai are pressed through a die. So is spaghetti.
→ In the pot, water creeps inward and starch granules swell. Al dente is a thin core still waiting.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox.how/noodleclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.title: How are noodles made? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
A noodle is starch held in a net, pressed into a thread and set by heat. Pull one rope of dough into 4,096 strands, cook a strand from the outside in, then run an instant noodle line: steam, wave, and a minute in 150 °C oil that leaves every strand full of pores.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox.how/e/noodleclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/noodleclear

In this video:
• Starch in a net. Flour is mostly hard starch granules.
• Cut, press or pull. Dough keeps its volume, so thinner means longer.
• Cooking from the outside in. In boiling water, heat reaches the centre of a strand in seconds, but water takes minutes, and starch cannot gelatinise without it.
• The instant noodle line. Strands fall onto a slower belt and buckle into waves, steam cooks the starch, and then about a minute in oil near 150 °C flashes the water to steam.
• Why two minutes. The block was cooked at the factory, so hot water only has to get back in, and the pores are open doors.
• One idea, many noodles. Ask what it is made of and how the strand was formed, and you can place hakka noodles, udon, ramen, lamian, spaghetti, idiyappam, sevai, flat rice noodles, glass noodles and falooda sev on one map.
